questions.question: Six letters X, T, S, M, R and O are written on different faces of a dice. Two positions of this dice are shown in the figures below. Find the letter on the face opposite to R.
questions.questionHtml: Six letters X, T, S, M, R and O are written on different faces of a dice. Two positions of this dice are shown in the figures below. Find the letter on the face opposite to R.
questions.solution:
From both dices, X is common and on the same surface. So, all remaining surface will be opposite to each other.

S → R
M → T
​X → O

So, S will be opposite to R.

questions.question: What will come in place of the question mark (?) in the following equation if ‘+’ and ‘×’ are interchanged and ‘–’ and ‘÷’ are interchanged? 16 − 2 × 42 + 13 ÷ 12 = ?
questions.questionHtml:
What will come in place of the question mark (?) in the following equation if ‘+’ and ‘×’ are interchanged and ‘–’ and ‘÷’ are interchanged?
16 − 2 × 42 + 13 ÷ 12 = ?
questions.solution:
Given equation: 16 − 2 × 42 + 13 ÷ 12 = ? 

After interchanging the signs then:

⇒ 16 ÷ 2 + 42 × 13 - 12 = ?  ⇒ ? = 8 + 42 × 13 - 12 ⇒ ? = 8 + 546 - 12 ⇒ ? = 554 - 12 = 542

'A & B' means ‘A is the brother of B’,
'A * B' means ‘A is the wife of B’ and
'A # B' means ‘A is the daughter of B’.
Which of the following means that S is the husband's brother's wife of M?

options.html: S * F & J ! I # M
S & F ! J * I # M
S & F # J ! I * M

questions.solution:
2. S * F & J ! I # M → S is the wife of F,  F is the brother of J, J is the father of I and I is the daughter of M.

Here, S is M's husband's brother's wife.

questions.question: Select the correct combination of mathematical signs to sequentially place from left to right in the blanks below to balance the given equation. 8 _ 27 _ 9 _ 6 _ 5 = 0
questions.questionHtml:
Select the correct combination of mathematical signs to sequentially place from left to right in the blanks below to balance the given equation. 
8 _ 27 _ 9 _ 6 _ 5 = 0
questions.solution:
Option 2) +, ÷, −, −

Mathematical signs to sequentially place from left to right:

⇒ 8 + 27 ÷ 9 - 6 - 5 = 0 ⇒ 8 + 3 - 6 - 5 = 0 ⇒ 11 - 6 - 5 = 0 ⇒ 11 - 11 = 0 ⇒ 0 = 0
